threads.title: Middle East operations capacity restoration
threads.note: Last mentioned Jun 2026; not repeated on the 2 calls since

history.speaker: Gaurav Negi
history.quote: We intend to kind of scale back to full capacity by the end of June, which incidentally then rolls into a peak period, which is for the Middle East in Q2.

threads.title: FY26 CASK ex-fuel guidance
threads.note: Came due (FY26); the reported numbers can't confirm it. Last mentioned Jan 2026; not repeated on the 3 calls since

history.speaker: Gaurav Negi
history.quote: We are currently estimating mid-single digit percentage increase in our unit costs excluding fuel and forex for the full financial year 2026 as compared to the full financial year 2025, this revised guidance is based on the revised capacity estimations.

threads.title: Q4FY26 capacity growth guidance
threads.note: Came due (Q4FY26); the reported numbers can't confirm it. Last mentioned Jan 2026; not repeated on the 3 calls since

history.speaker: Gaurav Negi
history.quote: Moving on to the forecast for the fourth quarter of this financial year, we are expecting to add capacity of around 10 percent as compared to the same period last year.

threads.title: Q4FY26 passenger unit revenue guidance
threads.note: Came due (Q4FY26); the reported numbers can't confirm it. Last mentioned Jan 2026; not repeated on the 3 calls since

history.speaker: Gaurav Negi
history.quote: Further, on the revenue side, basis the trends that we see in January, we are estimating an early to mid single digit moderation in our unit passenger revenue as compared to a high base of the same quarter last year which had a very strong tailwind in the form of the religious congregation for the Maha Kumbh.

threads.title: Q1FY27 capacity growth guidance
threads.note: Came due (Q1FY27); the reported numbers can't confirm it. Last mentioned Jun 2026; not repeated on the 2 calls since

history.speaker: Gaurav Negi
history.quote: With the capacity deployed in the last two months wherein middle east has seen an upward trajectory through April and May, we are expecting to add capacity of around 3-4 percent in Q1FY27 as compared to the same period last year.

threads.title: Q1FY27 passenger unit revenue growth estimate
threads.note: Came due (Q1FY27); the reported numbers can't confirm it. Last mentioned Jun 2026; not repeated on the 2 calls since

history.speaker: Gaurav Negi
history.quote: Further on the revenue side, based on booking and pricing trends observed across April and May, we currently estimate a mid-teens improvement in unit passenger revenue in Q1FY27 vs Q1FY26, primarily driven by the calibrated fuel charges which has been imposed, and a lower base during the same period last year due to the geopolitical developments in the Indian sub-continent.

threads.title: CASK ex fuel ex forex trend

history.speaker: Gaurav Negi
history.quote: While we've kind of seen a headwind CASK ex fuel ex forex, which is somewhere, we had guided it's going to be somewhere in the mid-single digit, at least for the coming quarters and depending on how things play out in terms of our utilization levels also, we foresee that it's going to be in mid- to high single digits is what our anticipation is right now.

history.speaker: Kiran Thadimarri
history.quote: On the cost side, we expect CASK ex fuel ex forex MTM to increase in the high single digits to early double digits range, largely reflecting the impact of rupee depreciation in addition to the usual escalations.

threads.title: Q2FY27 PRASK growth guidance
threads.note: Came due (Q2FY27); the reported numbers can't confirm it

history.speaker: Gaurav Negi
history.quote: In terms of unit passenger revenue or PRASK for Q2FY27, with the current balanced demand-supply equation and the higher fares holding up, we are expecting growth of more than 25% compared to the same period last year.

threads.title: International capacity share by 2030
threads.note: No reported number to check this against

history.speaker: Gaurav Negi
history.quote: We have said 40% that we'll be there by 2030. We were well on track in terms of deliveries of our both the XLRs, which are largely for international markets as well as the wide bodies that will also start coming in. So, we are holding to that 40% guidance.

history.speaker: Kiran Thadimarri
history.quote: Moving to our outlook for the third quarter of this financial year, we expect capacity to grow in the early single digit year-on-year.

threads.title: Q3FY27 PRASK growth guidance
threads.note: Segment or product-level target; segment numbers aren't in the reported tables

history.speaker: Kiran Thadimarri
history.quote: Based on the trends observed in October, we expect PRASK to grow by more than 25 percent year-on-year.

threads.title: FY27 full year capacity growth guidance

history.speaker: Kiran Thadimarri
history.quote: For the full financial year 2027, we expect capacity to grow in the early single digits.

history.speaker: Willie Walsh
history.quote: So right now, we're not changing the financial year '28 growth guidance of mid-teens.

synthesis.headline: Management routinely drops or leaves guidance unverifiable while profitability deteriorates sharply.

points.text: Annual revenue grew to 84,962 crore in Mar 2026, but annual PAT fell to -2,394 crore.
Operating margin dropped from 23.7% in Mar 2024 to 14.2% in Mar 2026, with quarterly margin at 8.2% in Sep 2026.
Middle East operations capacity restoration was dropped after being promised for June 2026.
Multiple operational and financial guidance metrics, including Q1FY27 capacity and Q2FY27 PRASK, remain unverifiable against reported tables.

bull.text: Cash from operations remained solid at 23,470 crore in Mar 2026.
Annual revenue increased consistently up to Mar 2026.

bear.text: Annual PAT swung into a net loss of -2,394 crore in Mar 2026.
Borrowings reached 87,303 crore with equity at 4,996 crore by Sep 2026.
